deep_one.name: Deep One
deep_one.note: They come up from Devil Reef in packs and keep to the dark side of every street. The old men of Innsmouth say they will not cross a fire; fire is no more than a nuisance to them.

innsmouth_hybrid.name: Innsmouth Hybrid
innsmouth_hybrid.note: A man to the waist and something else about the eyes: the Innsmouth look, the wide unblinking stare, the skin gone rough. Quicker than they seem, and they know the lanes better than you do.

dagon_priest.name: Esoteric Order of Dagon Priest
dagon_priest.note: The Order's priests wear the tiara from the church on New Church Green and chant from behind a screen of others. Kill the singer and the song goes on.

cthulhu_cultist.name: Cthulhu Cultist
cthulhu_cultist.note: A hooded man with a stone in his pocket and a chant he cannot pronounce. Brave in a crowd; the crowd is not usually far.

ghoul.name: Ghoul
ghoul.note: Pickman's friends: rubbery, doglike, crouching, fond of graveyards and good paintings. They are not mindless. They simply do not share your opinion of the dead.

ghast.name: Ghast
ghast.note: A ghast hunts by the dark and dies by the sun, which is why the Dreamlands keep their lamps lit. It leaps on its hooves, and it barks when it laughs.

zoog.name: Zoog
zoog.note: Small, brown and everywhere in the Enchanted Wood. Gentle if their mushrooms are left alone; quick, and many, if they are not.

night_gaunt.name: Night-gaunt
night_gaunt.note: Faceless, horned, silent, with a barbed tail. They carry sleepers off through the dark, tickle them, and set them down in strange places. They do not speak. They never have.

moon_beast.name: Moon-beast
moon_beast.note: Pale, slug-bodied, its blunt feelers never still: it sails its galley out of the Moon and trades slaves for rubies at Dylath-Leen. Stronger than it looks.

man_of_leng.name: Man of Leng
man_of_leng.note: The Men of Leng wear a turban and keep their mouths covered, and sell what they cannot name to the things in the monastery. They pass for human, which is the worst of it.

cat_from_saturn.name: Cat from Saturn
cat_from_saturn.note: Larger than any cat of Earth and unfriendly to a stranger who has never been kind to one. They hunt in rings, and the ring closes from behind.

wamp.name: Wamp
wamp.note: No one who describes a wamp agrees on its shape. All agree that it hunts the lanes beyond the Enchanted Wood and that it is quick.

gnorri.name: Gnorri
gnorri.note: The Gnorri build labyrinths under the sea and dislike the sun, and ask nothing of anyone. The ones that wander ashore want something.

serpent_man.name: Serpent Man of Valusia
serpent_man.note: The serpent people ruled the Earth before there were men. The ones that remain wear human faces badly, and rule from behind the eyes of the weak.

kn_yan_dweller.name: K'n-yan Dweller
kn_yan_dweller.note: The people of blue-litten K'n-yan have no use for the surface and little for each other. They are scholars of sensation, and pain is one of the arts.

ym_bhi.name: Y'm-bhi
ym_bhi.note: Y'm-bhi: the dead of K'n-yan, brought back from their tombs with the fire in the flesh and none of the mind. They are made to labour and they do not tire.

gyaa_yothn.name: Gyaa-yothn
gyaa_yothn.note: Hulking things bred in Yoth to carry loads: blind, strong, and loyal to nobody in particular.

reanimated_corpse.name: Reanimated Corpse
reanimated_corpse.note: West's work: a body made to walk by a serum that preferred fresher stock. It strikes without feeling and rots without minding. Fire ends it.

martense_degenerate.name: Martense Degenerate
martense_degenerate.note: The Martense line went under the mountain when the house fell and took on the habits of the place. They hunt on all fours in the dark, and thunder wakes them.

exham_troglodyte.name: Exham Priory Troglodyte
exham_troglodyte.note: Beneath Exham Priory the cellars and the rats are one tale. These are what the rats were guarding: pale, grey-eyed, and long since unable to say what they descend from.

rat_swarm.name: Rat Swarm
rat_swarm.note: A hundred small feet running toward you in a wave and a hundred small voices saying nothing at all. Fire turns them; a lantern held low parts them.

winged_hybrid.name: Winged Hybrid
winged_hybrid.note: At the Festival in Kingsport they come up out of the crypt on beaten wings in the shape of men, and nobody in the town will say why the old church bell is so slow.

moon_bog_wraith.name: Moon-Bog Wraith
moon_bog_wraith.note: The wraiths of the Moon-Bog: the shapes moonlight takes over a drowned village. Steel goes through them; light does not. They take the mind before the body.

being_of_ib.name: Being of Ib
being_of_ib.source: The Doom that Came to Sarnath
being_of_ib.note: Grey, bulging-eyed, froglike and mute: the dead city of Sarnath was built where they lived. They do not remember Sarnath. They have not forgotten it.

nameless_city_reptile.name: Nameless City Reptile
nameless_city_reptile.note: A crawling thing of the Nameless City, scaly, patient, as old as the desert. It lies in the low passages and moves only when you have gone in too far to turn.

hybrid_mummy.name: Hybrid Mummy
hybrid_mummy.note: Under the pyramid, in the black chambers: a man's body and a beast's head, wrapped, rising from a niche. Not dead, not alive, and not stopped by a door.

venusian_man_lizard.name: Venusian Man-Lizard
venusian_man_lizard.note: A thing of Venus, if the walls of Eryx are to be believed: a reptile with a man's bearing, speaking in the mind, doing quiet harm with a cold glass look.

beast_in_the_cave.name: The Beast in the Cave
beast_in_the_cave.note: What a guide led a boy toward in the dark of the great cave: white, blind, human in its gait. It is, in its way, still a man.

child_of_yig.name: Child of Yig
child_of_yig.note: Yig's children are many, and small, and they follow the scent of anyone who has hurt a snake. They are far better than you at finding you.

albino_penguin.name: Blind Albino Penguin
albino_penguin.note: A blind white bird that wanders the dark galleries beneath the ice, going toward the sound of its own feet. Miserable things. Their ancestors were bred.

gnoph_keh.name: Gnoph-keh
gnoph_keh.note: The hairy, many-limbed horror of the northern ice. It came down with the glaciers and hunted men, and it has not left off.

mi_go.name: Mi-Go
mi_go.note: The Fungi from Yuggoth: pinkish, crustaceous, winged, with a cluster of waving feelers where a head should be. Careful, quiet and unhurried. They take brains out and never quite finish.

elder_thing.name: Elder Thing
elder_thing.note: Barrel-bodied, star-headed, with membranous wings and tubular feelers. Not our enemy by temperament: they built a world and were undone by their own servants. Sometimes they are gentle.

shoggoth.name: Shoggoth
shoggoth.note: A protoplasmic mass that makes eyes and mouths at will. They obeyed once. They remember obeying. They say one thing, over and over, and it is not a word you want to hear near.

star_spawn.name: Star-spawn of Cthulhu
star_spawn.note: Star-spawn of Cthulhu: the ones that came down with the Great Old One. Octopus-headed, winged, and large enough to make a man think of mountains.

yithian.name: Yithian
yithian.note: The Great Race of Yith: rugose cones with claws and a trumpet-eyed head. They take what they need of other minds, and they put it back, mostly.

flying_polyp.name: Flying Polyp
flying_polyp.note: Half-visible, made of whistling, they keep to windowless towers and are seen only when they wish. The wind that comes before them is what you hear first.

gug.name: Gug
gug.note: The giants of the Dreamlands' under-vaults: hairy, long-armed, with a mouth that splits upward. They were put out of the upper world for an offence no one will name.

dhole.name: Dhole
dhole.note: A worm as wide as a house out of the deeps below the Dreamlands, rising through the earth and leaving nothing standing above it.

shantak.name: Shantak
shantak.note: A horse-headed, scaly, bat-winged bird the size of an elephant, ridden by the Men of Leng. Light drives it off. It does not care for a lamp.

formless_spawn.name: Formless Spawn of Tsathoggua
formless_spawn.note: Tsathoggua's spawn: a black mass that spreads and draws back, taking its shape from the last thing it ate. Fire is the one thing it prefers not to.

yekubian.name: Yekubian
yekubian.note: A being from the planet Yekub, who understood the human body better than its owner did, and spoke through the hum of the lamp.

being_from_beyond.name: Being from Beyond
being_from_beyond.note: What Tillinghast's resonator brought into sight: a jelly in the corner of the eye that is always there and always hungry. It is seen only by a mind that cannot rest.

thousand_young.name: Thousand Young of Shub-Niggurath
thousand_young.note: The Thousand Young of the Black Goat: black, rubbery, cloven-footed, ropy with tentacles. They are the Goat's brood, and the woods' answer to the farmer who cuts a tree.

colour_out_of_space.name: The Colour Out of Space
colour_out_of_space.note: Not a monster so much as a stain on the idea of colour. It drinks the life out of the land, and paints the dying in a shade that does not exist.

wilbur_whateley.name: Wilbur Whateley
wilbur_whateley.note: Wilbur Whateley came to his growth in a year and a half, stood seven feet tall at ten, and read the Necronomicon aloud in the barn in his grandfather's voice. He is not entirely his mother's son.

dunwich_horror.name: The Dunwich Horror
dunwich_horror.note: Wilbur's twin brother, if the word is allowed: it grew in the farmhouse on cattle, and cannot be seen without the Powder of Ibn Ghazi. It leaves tracks like a hogshead rolled through mud.

keziah_mason.name: Keziah Mason
keziah_mason.source: The Dreams in the Witch House
keziah_mason.note: A witch of 1692 who passed through the wall of a Salem gaol cell, and who keeps a rat with a human face to carry her messages. She knows where the corners lead.

brown_jenkin.name: Brown Jenkin
brown_jenkin.source: The Dreams in the Witch House
brown_jenkin.note: The rat with the little man's hands and the sharp yellow teeth. It runs between the walls of the Witch House, and it prefers the sleeping.

black_man.name: The Black Man
black_man.source: The Dreams in the Witch House
black_man.note: The Black Man of the witches' sabbath: tall, dark, never quite the shape of a man, writing in a book with a pen of ice. One of the thousand masks of the crawling chaos.

joseph_curwen.name: Joseph Curwen
joseph_curwen.source: The Case of Charles Dexter Ward
joseph_curwen.note: Curwen of Providence, who never aged, who sent for the Essential Saltes, and who killed the boy he had made himself resemble. He said the dead might be consulted. It was the dead who consulted him.

simon_orne.name: Simon Orne
simon_orne.source: The Case of Charles Dexter Ward
simon_orne.note: Simon Orne of Salem, who lived by the Saltes a hundred and fifty years, and wrote letters to Curwen in a hand that was the same at both ends of them.

edward_hutchinson.name: Edward Hutchinson
edward_hutchinson.source: The Case of Charles Dexter Ward
edward_hutchinson.note: Hutchinson, of Salem, known for his skill with a pendulum and his place at Curwen's table. Not on your side: simply the sort of man who can be reasoned with.

curwen_pit_thing.name: Thing in Curwen's Pits
curwen_pit_thing.source: The Case of Charles Dexter Ward
curwen_pit_thing.note: Down in the pits beneath Pawtuxet the failed answers to Curwen's questions are kept in the dark. One of them is not a failure, which is why it is chained.

ephraim_waite.name: Ephraim Waite
ephraim_waite.note: Ephraim Waite, of Innsmouth blood, who died and did not stop: he changed bodies as other men change coats, and his last was a young woman's.

haunter_of_the_dark.name: The Haunter of the Dark
haunter_of_the_dark.note: The thing that sleeps in the Starry Wisdom church, in the stone and the dark. It cannot abide light, and it is always in the room where the light has just gone out.

whisperer.name: The Whisperer in Akeley's Chair
whisperer.note: Something has sat down in Henry Akeley's chair; its hands are wax and its face is a mask. It will talk for hours about the stars, in a voice made of buzzing.

the_hound.name: The Hound
the_hound.note: The Hound of the amulet: it bays on the moor and in the mind. It will follow a thief across the sea for a stolen jade charm, and it has the patience of the grave.

the_unnamable.name: The Unnamable
the_unnamable.note: A thing that cannot be named is, in Carter's phrase, only a thing nobody has dared to name. The attic in Arkham had one. Manton was wrong.

shunned_house_entity.name: The Shunned House Entity
shunned_house_entity.note: In the cellar of the shunned house, a yellowish vapour with a human shape, and beneath it a mass that fed on whatever lived above. Fire and acid were not wasted.

lilith.name: Lilith
lilith.note: Lilith of the Red Hook ritual, bride of the Devil, in the shape of a woman who is not quite alive, whom Suydam brought from the East to marry on the night of the ceremony.

zann_window_thing.name: The Thing Beyond Erich Zann's Window
zann_window_thing.note: A chaos of music-fed darkness beyond a mansard window in the Rue d'Auseil, at the end of a street no one has found since. A viol held it back for years. The viol has stopped.

voice_in_the_tomb.name: The Voice in the Tomb
voice_in_the_tomb.note: At the foot of the tomb a voice says: "I am dead, and I am here. I am down here, where it is warm." It is, I think, the worst voice.

high_priest.name: High Priest Not to Be Described
high_priest.note: The High Priest Not to Be Described wears a yellow silk mask over a face no one has seen, and sits in a stone monastery on the cold waste of Leng, and plays a flute. One does not look at the hands.

eldritch.name: High Priest Not to Be Described

colossus_pyramids.name: The Colossus Beneath the Pyramids
colossus_pyramids.note: Under the pyramids, in the shaft below the Sphinx, the many-headed colossus that the mummies serve. Houdini saw its hands and fainted; the Egyptian priests are not surprised.

martins_beach_horror.name: The Horror at Martin's Beach
martins_beach_horror.note: What was washed up on the sand at Martin's Beach: vast, dying in the sun, not quite the shape of a whale. The children who touched it dreamed of it. They still do.

dr_munoz.name: Dr. Muñoz
dr_munoz.note: Dr. Muñoz keeps his rooms at fifty-five degrees, and an ammonia engine to cool his own flesh, and holds that life runs on will alone. It is a very good will.

charles_le_sorcier.name: Charles le Sorcier
charles_le_sorcier.note: Charles le Sorcier, of the house of C—, who took the elixir of Michel Mauvais and kept alive six hundred years, killing every heir who might have found him out. The last of the line.

medusa_gorgon.name: The Gorgon of Medusa's Coil
medusa_gorgon.note: A Gorgon of Medusa's Coil: a woman whose hair is a living thing and whose husband painted her. She looks at him as though from a long way back.

hypnos.name: Hypnos
hypnos.note: Hypnos, the god of sleep, who haunts a sculptor and his friend. The friend died of the dreams, and the sculptor will not say who he was. There is a face in the marble that is the sculptor's.

the_outsider.name: The Outsider
the_outsider.note: A thing out of a vault beneath a decayed castle, rotted, ghoulish, climbed up at last to the lit world. It is what the mirror shows when the mirror is true.

terrible_old_man.name: The Terrible Old Man
terrible_old_man.note: The Terrible Old Man of Kingsport keeps a shelf of bottles with lead pendulums that swing without wind. Three burglars tried his house. The bottles had not been swinging for fun.

zkauba.name: Zkauba the Wizard
zkauba.source: Through the Gates of the Silver Key
zkauba.note: Zkauba of Yaddith, a wizard who has pursued Carter through a hundred bodies, and whose temper is not improved by being outwitted.

cthulhu.name: Cthulhu
cthulhu.note: Cthulhu waits in R'lyeh, in the house of the dead one. Dreaming; not dead. The stars come right every so often, and it is easier than anyone expects to wake it.

father_dagon.name: Father Dagon
father_dagon.note: Father Dagon: the vast thing from the deeps that the Marshes worship, who will rise out of Devil Reef when the stars are right to raise the sleepers.

mother_hydra.name: Mother Hydra
mother_hydra.note: Mother Hydra, Dagon's consort, who rises beside him out of the same water in a body that has not forgotten what it is to be a mother.

hastur.name: Hastur
hastur.note: Hastur the Unspeakable, He Who Is Not To Be Named, in the black lake beside Carcosa. His name must not be said three times. It is easy to hear it said twice.

tsathoggua.name: Tsathoggua
tsathoggua.note: The toad-god of Zhothaqquah, dozing in black N'kai beneath K'n-yan. He is not cruel, and he is not kind, and the ones he eats have not asked for kindness.

ghatanothoa.name: Ghatanothoa
ghatanothoa.note: Ghatanothoa on Mount Yaddith-Gho: the thing whose sight turns flesh to stone and leaves the brain alive in it. Priests hid in the mountain's cave to cover their faces.

rhan_tegoth.name: Rhan-Tegoth
rhan_tegoth.note: Rhan-Tegoth, the Horror in the Museum: a pallid, six-limbed, ruffed thing on a black throne in a wax museum, fed on blood.

yig.name: Yig
yig.note: Yig, the Father of Serpents, merciful to snakes and unkind to those who harm them. The plains tribes say he is the god of the grass, and he does not forget.

bokrug.name: Bokrug
bokrug.source: The Doom that Came to Sarnath
bokrug.note: Bokrug, the great water-lizard of Ilarnek, whom the people of Sarnath killed and mocked, and whose children took back the city on an old night of the moon.

nug.name: Nug
nug.note: Nug and Yeb, twin gods from the pits of Yoth, spawned of Yog-Sothoth. Nug wears the dark. All it asks is that its sleep go undisturbed.

yeb.name: Yeb
yeb.note: Yeb is Nug's brother, or something larger than a brother. The people of Tsath do not pray to him. They sweep before his door.

great_ones.name: The Great Ones
great_ones.note: The gods of Earth, who dwell on Kadath: weak, and mild, and gone, who left a few strange things to guard the door.

azathoth.name: Azathoth
azathoth.note: The blind idiot god Azathoth, at the centre of ultimate chaos in a black void. The piping of the flutes is what keeps its dreaming in time.

daemon_pipers.name: The Daemon Pipers
daemon_pipers.note: The two pipers who play for Azathoth, shapeless, flute-voiced. They are the sounds the idiot god hears.

other_gods.name: The Other Gods
other_gods.note: The Other Gods, who guard the gods of Earth on Kadath. They are above all gods; they are not at all gods.

yog_sothoth.name: Yog-Sothoth
yog_sothoth.note: Yog-Sothoth is the gate. Yog-Sothoth is the key and the guardian of the gate. Past, present and future are one in Yog-Sothoth, which knows where the Old Ones broke through.

umr_at_tawil.name: 'Umr at-Tawil
umr_at_tawil.source: Through the Gates of the Silver Key
umr_at_tawil.note: 'Umr at-Tawil, the Prolonged of Life, Guardian of the Gate, the one the Silver Key is for: ancient beyond comfort. He opens the last door for those who have paid.

ancient_ones.name: The Ancient Ones
ancient_ones.source: Through the Gates of the Silver Key
ancient_ones.note: The Ancient Ones wait beyond the last gate, at the end of the dream: those who give the key the right to be turned.

shub_niggurath.name: Shub-Niggurath
shub_niggurath.note: Shub-Niggurath, the Black Goat of the Woods with a Thousand Young. The cry of the cloven, the cry of the forest; she gives; she devours; she has not been seen from the front.

nyarlathotep.name: Nyarlathotep
nyarlathotep.note: Nyarlathotep, the Crawling Chaos, the Soul and Messenger of the Other Gods: the tall dark man with the kind, polite voice, in every tongue and age, with a key on his watch chain.

nodens.name: Nodens
nodens.source: The Strange High House in the Mist
nodens.note: Nodens, Lord of the Great Abyss, who drives a chariot of a great shell drawn by dolphins and wears a smile that is not for you. A friend of Earth's gods, and old.

tritons.name: Tritons of Nodens' Court
tritons.source: The Strange High House in the Mist
tritons.note: The tritons of Nodens' court, who blow their curled conches on the Kingsport cliffs when his chariot comes. Bearers, not warriors. It is the first time anyone has asked them.

cats_of_ulthar.name: Cats of Ulthar
cats_of_ulthar.note: The cats of Ulthar, who have stood between the town and its enemies since the cottager and his wife. They will not hurt you if you have not hurt them.

pickman.name: Richard Upton Pickman
pickman.note: Richard Upton Pickman, painter of Boston, who disappeared and came back as one of the things he painted. Good company, in his way, and keeps a fine studio.

nasht_kaman_thah.name: Nasht & Kaman-Thah
nasht_kaman_thah.note: Nasht and Kaman-Thah, priests of Ulthar's Temple of the Elder Ones, who know the way to the Onyx Castle and will say if asked politely, and in the right order.

algol_light_being.name: The Light-Being from Algol
algol_light_being.note: The Light-Being from Algol comes to sleepers in their deepest dreams, a being of liquid light, with no malice. If anything it is curious about the human mind.

yithian_archivist.name: Yithian Archivist
yithian_archivist.note: An archivist of the Great Race, set to keep the Archives, with the gentle manner of one who has seen every age of the Earth and found them equally interesting.
